pages.title: Above the Canopy
pages.text: High above the forest lies the $(thing)Sky Spirit Forest$(). Stone islands of different sizes hang over the canopy, topped with grass and moss.$(br2)Streams on some islands spill over the edges as waterfalls. From the woods below, the water seems to fall out of the clouds.

pages.title: Island Life
pages.text: Spirit Trees, bamboo, flowers and mushrooms grow on the islands, where $(thing)Spirit Monkeys$() can also be found.$(br2)Look for $(item)Hipokute Grass$() and $(item)Spirit Recovery Herb$() among the plants. The trees may bear $(item)Spirit Fruit$() and $(item)Lightning-Struck Wood Lingzhi$().
